blog_title: T-Shirt Raw Material Shortage — Why Negotiating Too Hard Hurts Fabric Availability for Bulk Orders
caption:
**Maal Kam Ho Toh Negotiation Kyun Mushkil?** 📦

When yarn and fabric supply is tight and multiple buyers compete for the same stock, spending too much time negotiating the price down can mean the material gets allocated to someone else before you confirm your order. You may win on price but lose on availability—and a delayed blank means a delayed print job, missed delivery, and damaged customer trust.

This isn't an argument against negotiating. It's about reading the supply situation correctly first. During shortage seasons (cotton yarn, dyed fabric, finished blanks), each production stage has a throughput limit. A shortage at any one point compresses supply across all downstream stages.

**Have you lost stock to a competitor while negotiating rate, or secured material by deciding quickly?** Share your experience—or save this for your next supplier conversation. 💼
